summary: The diff implements a comprehensive Daily Production Report feature with backend data structures, CRUD operations, frontend UI components, and navigation integration. All requirements appear to be addressed with proper authentication, forms, tables, and filtering capabilities following the industrial dashboard theme.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration system (backend/migration.mo) for upgrading old actor state to include dailyProductionReports
hallucinated_features.reason: Migration functionality was not requested in the BuildRequest. The requirement was to create a new data structure and CRUD operations, not to provide backward-compatible migration from an old system state.

hallucinated_features.description: Lookup by ID-based system with separate DailyProductionReportWithId type in backend
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-8 specifies id as a primary key field within the DailyProductionReport structure, but the implementation creates a separate wrapper type DailyProductionReportWithId and uses Map-based storage with auto-incrementing IDs. This architectural choice was not specified in requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Update and delete operations using array index lookup by date and operation_name combination
hallucinated_features.reason: The update and delete hooks find records by matching date and operation_name, then use array indexOf to derive an ID. This complex lookup mechanism was not specified in REQ-10 which only required operations by id.
